paragraphs.source_en: On the twenty-fifth day of the fourth month of Tenshō 13, Hashiba Hideyoshi, Minister of the Right, returned in triumph from Kii to Osaka. On the seventh day of the sixth month, Tokugawa Ieyasu completed an inspection tour from Kai to Shinano and then returned to Hamamatsu.

paragraphs.source_en: Ieyasu reckoned that Hideyoshi, having only just returned to Osaka, would not take the field at once. He therefore made a show of traveling from place to place, using the interval to shelter the remnants of the Kii forces and to meet a secret envoy from Sassa Narimasa along the way. Ieyasu chose to return to Hamamatsu Castle early in the sixth month because he knew that Hideyoshi had begun his assault on Toyama Castle and had dispatched troops to Hokuriku.
